description: This file implements the VssDatabase class, which manages a hierarchical JSON-based data structure representing a Vehicle Signal Specification (VSS) tree. It provides methods for initializing the tree from a JSON file, querying paths, checking permissions, applying default values, updating signals, and retrieving metadata. The class interacts with external components such as logging, subscription handling, and JSON processing libraries.

classes.name: VssDatabase
classes.description: Manages a hierarchical JSON structure representing vehicle signal data, providing methods for initialization, querying, updating, and metadata management.

methods.name: isActor
methods.description: Checks if a JSON element represents an actuator based on its 'type' field.

methods.name: isSensor
methods.description: Checks if a JSON element represents a sensor based on its 'type' field.

methods.name: isAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a JSON element represents an attribute based on its 'type' field.

methods.name: applyDefaultValues
methods.description: Recursively applies default values to attribute nodes in the VSS tree.

methods.name: initJsonTree
methods.description: Initializes the VSS data and meta trees from a JSON file.

methods.name: pathExists
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists in the VSS tree.

methods.name: pathIsWritable
methods.description: Determines if a path is writable (i.e., is an actor or sensor).

methods.name: pathIsAttributable
methods.description: Checks if a specific attribute can be set on a path.

methods.name: pathIsReadable
methods.description: Checks if a path is readable (i.e., is an actor, sensor, or attribute).

methods.name: checkPathValid
methods.description: Verifies if a path contains usable leaf nodes.

methods.name: getDatatypeForPath
methods.description: Retrieves the datatype of a path, throws if not found or not readable.

methods.name: getLeafPaths
methods.description: Returns all leaf node paths under a given path.

methods.name: setSignal
methods.description: Sets the value of a signal at a specified path and publishes the update.

methods.name: getSignal
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a signal at a specified path.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Retrieves metadata information for a given path.

methods.name: updateMetaData
methods.description: Updates metadata for a specific path with new information.
